_note: Baidu photos of the check-in hall and an easyJet apron scene, plus an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

agp-baidu-1.webp.zh: 航站楼出发大厅内：高挑的天花板上装着大型吊扇，旅客拖着行李走向值机柜台与登机口指示牌。
agp-baidu-1.webp.en: Inside the departures hall, large ceiling fans hang over travellers making their way to check-in and the gate signs.

agp-baidu-2.webp.zh: 停机坪上：一架易捷航空客机停在廊桥旁，地勤设备排列在前景，远处有飞机起飞，背后是群山。
agp-baidu-2.webp.en: On the apron, an easyJet airliner at the stand with ground equipment in the foreground, a departing aircraft beyond and mountains behind.

agp-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，马拉加机场（AGP）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
agp-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Málaga-Costa del Sol Airport (AGP) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
